newsitem.title: USA: Rochester Medical prepares for FDA filing.
newsitem.headline: Rochester Medical prepares for FDA filing.

text.p: Rochester Medical Corp said Thursday it will seek approval from the Food and Drug Administration for its Antibacterial Foley catheter in the coming weeks.

Rochester Medical President Anthony Foley also announced the launch of clinical testing of its Femsoft female continence insert and plans to complete construction of its new manufacturing facility by mid-1997.
The company earlier reported sales of $1.7 million, an 80-percent increase compared to year-ago sales of $957,999, and a net loss of $504,580 in the first quarter.
Rochester Medical develops medical catheters and other urological and continence devices.
Its shares closed down 1/4 Thursday afternoon at 20.
